findings.title: Invalidate connected calendars after deleting the cache
findings.body: The cache deletion success handler only invokes the optional onSuccess callback; it never invalidates the connectedCalendars query that supplies cacheUpdatedAt. The wrapper passes its optional external onChanged callback rather than a query refetch, and disables refetchOnWindowFocus. When no refetching callback is supplied, successful deletion therefore leaves the old cache timestamp and deletion action visible until the page is reloaded. Invalidate utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars on success, as the disconnect mutation already does.

findings.title: Use an in-place edit command that also works on Linux
findings.body: The command `sed -i '' -E ...` uses BSD/macOS syntax. With GNU sed on Linux, the empty argument is treated as the script or an input filename and the command fails instead of updating an existing GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL entry. The script does not check the exit status and still prints that the URL was updated, leaving webhook tests pointed at the old tunnel. Use a portable edit strategy or select the appropriate sed syntax for the host platform.
